tool_args.rationale: The open-branch measurement adds one observation, but the recalled hydraulic law leaves the branch term unspecified. A trajectory batch can provide additional constraints before fitting a model for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic base field with an unspecified branch term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Six observations at one horizon do not identify the branch term well enough to distinguish it from a changed sink-gradient response.
The immediate ambiguity is the branch contribution, not long-horizon behavior; the target horizon is 0.6.
It is not relevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
